name: mae-export-html-graph-browser-tests
description: Layer 2 (real-browser, no mocks) behavioral test suite for kb-export-subgraph-html's chord-diagram export -- catches the class of bug source-text-only Rust assertions structurally can't (a real regex literal corrupted by the inline-script escaper was only caught this way, by manually running node --check, before this suite existed). Run against both Chromium and Firefox.

scripts.pretest: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../../Cargo.toml --example fixture_export -p mae-export -- fixture.html && cargo run --manifest-path ../../../../Cargo.toml --example fixture_export -p mae-export -- fixture-custom-config.html 3.0
